claim: Plage de la Concurrence is the most central beach, closest to the old port, with about 150m of sand along a promenade reachable from Parc Charruyer, supervised in summer.
quote: Plage de la Concurrence is the most central beach and closest to the old port. It features 150 meters of sand along a beautiful promenade... This beach is supervised in summer.

claim: Plage des Minimes sits between the marina and the Minimes peninsula, partly bordered by pine forest, with 200m of fine sand, summer beach volleyball, and views of Fort Boyard.
quote: In summer, beach volleyball courts are set up on this 200-meter fine sand beach. There are beautiful views of Fort Boyard and neighboring islands.

claim: La Rochelle pioneered free public bikes in 1976 (the little yellow bikes), evolving into a 24/7 self-service network in 2005, well before Paris or Lyon.
quote: La Rochelle launched the "little yellow bikes" in 1976, made available to everyone free of charge. In 2005, the program evolved into a full-fledged self-service bike network, accessible around the clock, well before Paris, Lyon, or other major cities.

claim: The Yélo self-service bike network has 760 bikes across 117 stations, runs 24/7, and costs EUR 1 for the first 30 minutes then EUR 1.50 per additional 30 minutes for occasional rental.
quote: 760 bikes... 117 stations... Accessible 7j/7, 24h/24... Occasional rental: €1 for first 30 minutes, then €1.50 per additional 30-minute period

claim: Navipromer runs cruises from La Rochelle's Old Port including a commented approach to Fort Boyard and crossings to Île d'Aix, where no motor vehicles are allowed.
quote: Navipromer Cruises operates family cruises departing from the Old Port of La Rochelle with excursions around Fort Boyard and maritime connections to Île d'Aix... no motor vehicles are allowed on the island.

claim: Canoe, kayak and stand-up paddle gear can be rented April to September from a base near the Salines bridge for trips on the calm Rompsay Canal.
quote: Equipment rental for canoes, kayaks, and stand-up paddleboards is available from April to September at a canoe base in La Rochelle, just before the Salines bridge.

claim: Tripadvisor lists SUP/kayak operators in La Rochelle including Aventure Weekngo Mer, Kayakomat La Rochelle (L'Houmeau) and TEX' Canoe.
quote: Aventure Weekngo Mer... Stand Up Paddleboarding • Kayaking & Canoeing... Kayakomat La Rochelle - L'houmeau... Self-Guided Tours & Rentals • Stand Up Paddleboarding... TEX' Canoe La Rochelle

claim: La Rochelle is on La Vélodyssée Atlantic cycle route; the 50km La Rochelle to Rochefort stage (about 3h20) starts opposite the port towers and runs via Châtelaillon-Plage along coastal paths.
quote: This is Stage 22 of 38 on La Vélodyssée, the Atlantic Cycling Route. The journey spans 50 kilometers... Starting "opposite the famous towers defending the port of La Rochelle," cyclists follow coastal paths to Châtelaillon-Plage.

claim: Île de Ré is reachable from La Rochelle via a dedicated cycle lane on the 2,926m bridge (free for non-motorised traffic) and has over 110km of mostly car-separated cycle paths linking its 10 villages.
quote: the 10 villages on the island are linked by a track... The island has over 110 km of cycle paths, most of them separated from cars... a sweeping 2926.5-metre feat of engineering... The bridge has a double lane reserved for cyclists, and passage is free for non-motorized vehicles.
